words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not restart the scene. It fastens the whole wealth-love clause to the earlier accusations as another coordinate charge, so the reader hears motive being added to public economic failure rather than a new episode beginning. Because it is prefixed to {{ar:تُحِبُّونَ}} ({{tr:tuḥibbūna}}), continuation and accusation arrive together with no new scene marker or named subject. The short connector also keeps the rebuke accumulating in sound and syntax, carrying the same addressed plural from the inheritance-devouring charge into the love-of-wealth diagnosis.

words.prose: {{ar:تُحِبُّونَ}} ({{tr:tuḥibbūna}}) makes the charge communal and ongoing: the addressees themselves keep directing preference toward {{ar:ٱلْمَالَ}} ({{tr:al-māla}}). The Form IV love branch is not a vague feeling here; with an explicit object it names wealth as the chosen value target, emotionally dear and practically ranked, while remote seed or social-affection branches stay outside this verb frame. After the failure to urge feeding in 89:18 and the devouring of inheritance in 89:19, this first lexical action exposes the motive: a value-priority construction in which outward exploitation and inward desire belong to one continuous accusation. The verb then receives its own cognate measure in {{ar:حُبًّۭا}} ({{tr:ḥubban}}), so love is heard first as action and then as a measured state before {{ar:جَمًّۭا}} ({{tr:jamman}}) names its excess. The reported person-prefix variant shifts the stance from direct confrontation to third-person exposure, but the same verb, object, and cognate-measure structure remain.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَالَ}} ({{tr:al-māla}}) is the accusative object of {{ar:تُحِبُّونَ}} ({{tr:tuḥibbūna}}), so the diagnosis is not desire in general but attachment fastening onto wealth. Its definiteness gathers wealth into a recognizable class of owned value, wider than coin or cash: property, possessions, goods, assets, and usable means can all stand inside the object field. The surface noun names already-objectified value rather than making acquisition, funding, or a merely financial relation the predicate, keeping the diagnostic focus on what has become beloved. After the failures toward orphan, poor, and inheritance in 89:17-19, this broad object field shows where withheld care has been redirected. Placed between the love verb and {{ar:حُبًّۭا}} ({{tr:ḥubban}}), wealth is caught inside doubled love language; the target is named first, then the clause reveals how swollen the love is.

words.prose: {{ar:حُبًّۭا}} ({{tr:ḥubban}}) is the cognate accusative of {{ar:تُحِبُّونَ}} ({{tr:tuḥibbūna}}), not a second loved object. It repeats the act as a named measure, turning love for {{ar:ٱلْمَالَ}} ({{tr:al-māla}}) into something inspectable and excessive in quantity or kind. Its indefiniteness leaves the measure open until {{ar:جَمًّۭا}} ({{tr:jamman}}) qualifies it, so the final phrase diagnoses both inward attachment and practical preference. The same root has remote seed and kernel branches, but this gerund stays in the affective love field while letting the repeated sound make attachment answer itself. Because the measure comes after the wealth object, the target appears first and then love closes back over it as intensified state. The contrast with giving food despite love for it (76:8) sharpens the reversal: here love clings to wealth, and the intensified consumption pattern of 89:19 is recast as intensified affection.

words.prose: {{ar:جَمًّۭا}} ({{tr:jamman}}) is the final adjective of {{ar:حُبًّۭا}} ({{tr:ḥubban}}), so the abundance belongs to the love and not directly to the amount of property. Its root pressure pictures excess as gathered fullness: piled, massed, overflowing attachment rather than merely strong emotion. Because it closes the ayah, the last pressure left in the ear is not wealth alone but love accumulated beyond measure. The same-surah pattern with the prior intensified consumption phrase in 89:19 makes the final word a motive-level handoff: what was swept together in action is now heaped up in affection. Its rarity, doubled consonant, and matching accusative ending with {{ar:حُبًّۭا}} ({{tr:ḥubban}}) make the closure feel grammatically sealed and heavy before the abrupt break in 89:21.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ح ب ب at words 1 and 3 encloses wealth at word 2, while جَمًّا at word 4 qualifies the enacted love.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clinging attachment drives acquisition, and acquisition feeds a gathered fullness. The cognate verb-noun repetition makes desire itself accumulate alongside its object, so abundance describes both the wealth and the affective pressure around it.

activation_trace.role: Love as clinging attachment supplies the affective bond that keeps the subject oriented toward wealth.
Acquiring and possessing wealth supplies the repeatable material process on which attachment can act.
Gathered abundance filling a measure turns the terminal qualifier into saturation rather than a bare degree word.

changed_reading.after: The clause diagnoses a clinging attachment whose acquisition keeps gathering until wealth and desire alike press toward fullness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second-person plural subject, the approval branch of ح ب ب, and the collective branch of ج م م all remain attached to loving wealth.
baseline_models.mechanism: A plural audience does not merely share many private desires; it can form a crowd that approves wealth as the common measure of what deserves desire. Public commendation and collective massing reinforce one another.

activation_trace.role: A formula of approval and utmost desire lets love function as social commendation, not only inward feeling.
Wealth as acquired possession supplies the publicly legible object around which valuation can converge.
A massed crowd or inclusive group gives the plural love a collective body.

changed_reading.before: Many individuals happen to love wealth.
changed_reading.after: The plural community collectively ratifies wealth as desirable, making its love a socially self-reinforcing valuation regime.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus repeats ح ب ب and closes with جَمًّا, allowing secondary branches of fixity, filling, and recovery to remain tethered to the clause's attachment and intensity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wealth promises to fill and rest the desiring subject, yet the attachment can fix that subject in place like an exhausted animal. The desired satiation and the resulting incapacity coexist as two sides of the same possessive loop.

activation_trace.role: An exhausted animal fixed in place supplies the surprising image of desire becoming immobilization.
Filling a vessel or drinker to repletion supplies the promise of satiation that keeps acquisition running.
Rest and recovered strength supply the repose wealth-love seeks but may fail to deliver.

changed_reading.before: Intense love energetically drives the pursuit of wealth.
changed_reading.after: The pursuit is also a self-stalling search for satiation: it promises replenishment while fastening the lover to the place of exhaustion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The seed branch of ح ب ب, the acquisition branch of م و ل, and the clustered young-growth branch of ج م م all arise from roots present in the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wealth is loved as seed stock: a carried kernel valued less for present use than for its capacity to multiply. The gathered but not yet mature vegetation image makes abundance prospective, converting possession into imagined future growth.

activation_trace.role: A carried seed-grain supplies a small unit whose value lies in storage and multiplication.
Acquired property turns the seed image into capital held for increase.
Clustered young herbage supplies growth gathered before fruition, making the abundance anticipatory.

changed_reading.before: The clause condemns attachment to a large present quantity.
changed_reading.after: It can also expose attachment to wealth as reproductive potential, loving the stored kernel for the future increase imagined inside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening arithmetic activates a distributive reading of gathered wealth. Joining a neighbor's share to one's own property makes one holding larger while leaving a right deficient elsewhere; division and restraint are the blocked counteroperations. Excess is therefore relational, not merely numerical.

activation_trace.role: Property acquisition supplies the holding to which another share can be annexed.
Gathered fullness supplies the enlarged result of annexation.
Adding a neighbor's share to one's property supplies the concrete operation of acquisitive joining.
A deficit that strips a right supplies the loss produced on the other side of the joining.
Separating an allotted share supplies the distributive operation that accumulation overrides.
Restraint and enclosure supply a boundary against taking beyond one's portion.

structural_cues: The opening sequence places paired and single side by side, then asks about an oath for one possessing restraint.
In the focus clause, wealth is positioned between repeated love and the final gathering qualifier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies annexation, a right-producing deficit, apportionment, and restraint; I infer the directional arrow that one person's gathered holding can be another person's missing share. A live alternative is that the opening arithmetic remains ceremonial and has no property mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Excessive wealth-love means wanting a greater quantity.
changed_reading.after: Excessive wealth-love can mean enlarging one's holding by absorbing apportioned shares, so abundance registers a distributive injury elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accumulated resources become supports and fixed structures, then collective capacity becomes overflow beyond limits and multiplies disorder. The focus love is thus an affective engine for durable systems of power, not only a private appetite.

activation_trace.role: Acquired wealth supplies the stock from which durable capacity can be built.
A massed collective supplies the social scale at which wealth becomes institutional capacity.
The supporting middle that holds a thing upright supplies an infrastructural form for stored power.
Peg-like fixity supplies the hardening of accumulated capacity into an entrenched order.
Rising, sweeping water supplies the transition from capacity to limit-crossing overflow.
Numerical growth supplies the multiplier by which the consequences spread.
Departure from sound order supplies the system-level result of that multiplied overflow.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from pillars, unique construction, carved rock, and pegs to transgression and increased corruption.
The historical agents are plural collectives, matching the plural addressee of the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies structural support, fixity, overflow, increase, and loss of sound order; I infer that gathered wealth finances and stabilizes the capacity linking them. The live alternative is that the monuments only identify past peoples and do not model wealth's operation.

changed_reading.before: The verse targets private or collectively fashionable acquisitiveness.
changed_reading.after: The verse can target love of accumulated wealth as the fuel by which a collective builds entrenched capacity, exceeds limits, and reproduces disorder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired tests show material expansion being read as honor and constricted provision being read as humiliation. Love of wealth therefore acts as an epistemic metric: it translates changing allotments into claims about personal worth and divine regard.

activation_trace.role: Approval and utmost desire let attachment to wealth become a formula for judging what counts as honor.
Possessed wealth supplies the visible quantity used as the false status gauge.
A test that makes a condition manifest supplies the frame in which the subject's valuation is exposed.
Commendable honor and generosity supply the moral status that the speaker wrongly equates with material expansion.
A good, favored condition supplies the experienced ease from which the honor claim is inferred.
Constricting something to a small measure supplies the material contraction misread as devaluation.
An apportioned gift supplies the allotted resource whose amount fluctuates without fixing worth.
Humiliation through contempt supplies the negative status the speaker projects onto restricted provision.

structural_cues: Verses 15 and 16 repeat the test-condition-speech frame while reversing expansion and restriction.
The abrupt rejection at 89:17 breaks the subject's equation between material condition and moral rank.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, honor, ease, measured restriction, apportioned provision, and humiliation; I infer that wealth-love is the conversion rule from allotment to self-worth. A live alternative is that the two false speeches concern gratitude alone and are not generated by the later attachment.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns wealth as an excessively desired object.
changed_reading.after: The focus also condemns wealth as a false instrument of knowledge, used to infer honor from abundance and humiliation from restriction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attachment to acquired wealth blocks the outward movement of honor, urging, food, and sustaining provision toward people whose social or material support has been cut. The fault is not static possession alone but a failed circulation that leaves another person unable to settle.

activation_trace.role: Clinging attachment supplies the inward retention that resists release.
Acquired property supplies what could circulate but remains captured by attachment.
A child cut off from a caretaker supplies the broken support relation that wealth should bridge.
Urging toward an act supplies the missing social impulse that would set resources in motion.
Feeding another supplies the concrete outward transfer opposed to possessive retention.
Sustenance that enables settled continuance supplies the human outcome blocked when food does not circulate.

structural_cues: The repeated negations at 89:17-18 describe omitted outward actions immediately before the paired consumption and love clauses.
The same second-person plural moves through failure to honor, failure to urge, consumption, and love.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severed care, social urging, feeding, and sustenance that stabilizes life; I infer the causal arrow that clinging to wealth interrupts this circulation. A live alternative is that the omissions are parallel vices without wealth-retention as their mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses a blockage in social circulation: attachment holds resources inward while honor, encouragement, food, and stability fail to reach exposed dependents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding clause turns property transfer into consumption and gathers what was dispersed into one intake. Its cognate-accusative rhythm is echoed by love-abundance in the focus, so the affect names the appetite that assimilates inherited claims into an undifferentiated holding.

activation_trace.role: Clinging attachment supplies the appetite that persists after each acquisition.
Acquisition supplies the property form produced by consuming transferred assets.
Gathered fullness supplies the single amassed result into which distinctions disappear.
Consuming or taking wealth supplies the operative mode of appropriation rather than a metaphor of appetite alone.
Property passing from a predecessor to successors supplies a field of claims vulnerable to appropriation.
Receiving possession without contract or labor sharpens the low-friction transfer that appetite can capture.
Collecting scattered parts supplies the collapse of separate portions into one consuming grasp.

structural_cues: The adjacent clauses share second-person plural verbs followed by emphatic cognate nouns and terminal gathering qualifiers.
Consumption of inheritance directly precedes love of wealth, allowing action and affect to explain one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth-consumption, inherited transfer, and gathering dispersed parts; I infer that the gathering erases distinctions among claims as assets are assimilated. A live alternative is the simpler reading of indiscriminate greed without a specific claim-erasure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an emotion that follows a separate act of greedy eating.
changed_reading.after: The focus names the operating appetite of inheritance appropriation: transferred portions are consumed, gathered into one holding, and then loved as amassed wealth.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, gathered mass is leveled, persons are ordered into rows, and regret concerns what was not advanced for life. Wealth-love now appears as a temporal error: value is retained and fixed in the present when its beneficial form would have been value sent ahead; retention ends in binding rather than security.

activation_trace.role: Fixity caused by exhaustion supplies the stalled motion of value kept beside its possessor.
Possessed wealth supplies the value whose temporal direction is at issue.
A filled, gathered mass supplies the stock that appears secure before leveling.
Pounding and demolition to an even level supply the cancellation of accumulated topography.
Alignment on a level line supplies an ordered alternative to indiscriminate massing.
Movement forward and precedence supply the missing direction that retained value failed to take.
Life as benefit and good supplies the end toward which value should have been advanced.
A fastening bond supplies the terminal reversal of possessions imagined as security.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence moves from repeated leveling and repeated rows to retrospective speech about what was sent ahead.
The focus gathers value around the present possessor, while 89:24 grammatically projects action forward toward life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies leveling, alignment, forward movement, beneficial life, and binding; I infer the arrow that retained wealth is stalled value and that outwardly advanced value would have become benefit. A live alternative is that what should have been advanced denotes deeds generally, with no special reference to wealth.

changed_reading.before: The problem is having and loving too much wealth now.
changed_reading.after: The problem is also wealth's arrested direction: value amassed beside the self is leveled and becomes binding, while the regretted value is what was never advanced into life-giving benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending does not merely suppress desire; it reorients attachment from owning an object to being received into reciprocal relation, service, community, and a sheltered garden. Gatheredness also changes direction: instead of pulling goods into the self, the self returns and enters a larger belonging.

activation_trace.role: Clinging attachment supplies a relational capacity whose object and direction can be changed.
A gathered people supplies the alternative form of abundance as belonging rather than possession.
A precious thing over which selves compete relocates value from external property to the addressed self.
Settled tranquility supplies non-possessive security before movement and entry.
Return to a prior relation reverses the inward pull of acquisition.
Mutual satisfaction supplies reciprocity in place of one-way possession.
Entering an interior supplies movement of the self into belonging instead of movement of goods into the self.
Humble service supplies a relational identity opposed to sovereignty through ownership.
A garden sheltered by vegetation supplies a received enclosure unlike a hoard built around the self.

structural_cues: The discourse shifts from a plural subject actively loving wealth to a singular self addressed by commands to return and enter.
The ending repeats relational possessives and the imperative of entry rather than verbs of acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precious selfhood, tranquility, return, reciprocal acceptance, entry, service, and sheltered belonging; I infer that this sequence forms a countergrammar to possessive attachment. A live alternative is that the ending describes reward independently and does not deliberately reroute the focus's love.

changed_reading.before: The answer to excessive wealth-love is simply less desire or less wealth.
changed_reading.after: The ending permits a different answer: attachment and gatheredness are rerouted from drawing property into the self toward returning, reciprocal acceptance, and entry into a community not possessed by the entrant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries water dynamics across lexically different roots, but it remains valid as a mechanism because filling and gathered water are direct branches of focus roots and the context supplies rupture, overflow, pouring, and leveling. Downstream prose should present it as a cross-domain hydraulic analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The filling branch of ح ب ب and the well-water fullness included in ج م م attach the reservoir image directly to the love and abundance of 89:20.

activation_trace.role: Filling a drinker or vessel supplies the intake phase of a reservoir mechanism.
Water gathering abundantly in a well supplies stored fullness.
A large quantity bursting out suddenly supplies release after pressure.
Rising water with sweeping force supplies overflow beyond a containing limit.
Pouring out supplies a forced reversal of the prior intake.
Demolition to level ground supplies the terminal loss of every retaining wall and mound.

changed_reading.before: Great love is a static emotional intensity attached to a large stock.
changed_reading.after: Wealth-love behaves like hydraulic capture: intake fills a reserve, gathered pressure crosses its boundary, and the context answers accumulation with outpouring and leveling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the exhausted-animal branch of ح ب ب is form-distant from ordinary love, but it remains anchored in the repeated focus root and gains contrast from tranquility immediately followed by return. Downstream prose should qualify it as a contrast between two kinds of stillness, not claim that تُحِبُّونَ literally means immobilization.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ح ب ب supplies exhausted fixity while ج م م supplies recovered rest; the ending tests that ambiguity with a tranquil self commanded to move.

activation_trace.role: An exhausted animal unable to leave its place supplies pathological stillness.
Rest that restores strength supplies the repose falsely sought in accumulated wealth.
Tranquil settling supplies a non-exhausted stillness compatible with response.
Active return supplies the movement that genuine tranquility can release.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is loved because it promises rest and replenishment.
changed_reading.after: The clause may expose counterfeit rest: possessive attachment leaves the lover stuck from depletion, whereas tranquility is a settled strength capable of returning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the spider sense of م و ل is anomalous and reported conditionally, but it remains directly anchored to the focus root and is activated by later branches of binding, interwoven entry, and concealed enclosure. Downstream prose must label the web as a heuristic image and never present spider as the lexical meaning of ٱلْمَالَ here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The anomalous spider branch belongs to the focus word for wealth, while the repeated love root supplies the clinging force that makes a self-produced enclosure imaginable.

activation_trace.role: The reported spider term supplies the web-like geometry of wealth as an enclosure produced around its holder.
Clinging attachment supplies the adhesive force by which the enclosure holds.
A fastening bond supplies the trap-like outcome of the self-enclosure.
Interpenetrating parts and interior spaces supply the woven structure and introduce an alternative act of entry.
A place of concealment supplies the contrast between entrapment in a self-made enclosure and entry into a received shelter.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a passive object that the subject grips.
changed_reading.after: In the contained web image, attachment spins acquired wealth into an enclosure that grips its maker, while the ending offers entry into a shelter the self does not construct or own.

strongest_changes: The opening pair-share-restraint branches changed quantity into distribution: one amassed holding can encode another person's missing share.
The test pair changed wealth from an object of desire into a false metric that converts provision into claims of honor or humiliation.
The orphan, feeding, inheritance, and consumption sequence changed inward greed into blocked circulation and active assimilation of transferred claims.
The post-focus movement from leveling to regret over what was not advanced changed accumulation into stalled value.
The final return, mutual acceptance, and entry preserved attachment as a capacity but rerouted it from possession toward reciprocal belonging.
summary.what_was_special: The trace repeatedly converted جَمًّا from a generic intensifier into mechanisms of filling, crowding, annexation, erased shares, institutional capacity, stalled stock, and alternative communal gathering. Several branches also reversed the apparent direction of agency: the subject who gathers wealth can become fixed, bound, or enclosed by what was gathered.
remaining_uncertainties: The share-annexation reading depends on treating the opening pair, single, division, and restraint sequence as distributive rather than ceremonial.
The monumental-capacity reading infers an economic substrate beneath political construction and transgression; the packet supplies the stages but not that causal link.
The seed-stock, hydraulic, counterfeit-rest, and web readings are branch-mediated analogies and must not be promoted into replacement lexical translations.
The final sequence may countermodel possessive love, or it may function as an independent eschatological resolution without directly reusing the focus mechanism.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Love of wealth as clinging fullness in the heart.** Lexical evidence: `ح ب ب B002` love as clinging attachment; `ح ب ب B004` the heart’s inner kernel; `م و ل B001` wealth/property; `ج م م B001` abundant gathered fullness. Structural cue: the root `ح ب ب` is doubled verbally and nominally, then intensified by `جمًّا`. Assigned role: love is not casual preference but a full inner adhesion to property. Abductive move: I infer that repetition plus `ج م م` turns affect into a container filled to capacity. Reading change: the ayah reads as interior congestion around wealth.

2. **Seed-potential trapped by accumulation.** Lexical evidence: `ح ب ب B001` seed-grain as carried kernel; `ج م م B005` young clustered herbage; `ك ر م B002` good growth and rain-bearing bounty; `ر ز ق B003` rain as provision. Structural cue: the packet repeatedly offers rain/growth/provision branches, but the social sequence hoards rather than circulates. Assigned role: wealth-love stores seed-like potential without letting it become provision for orphan and poor. Abductive move: I infer ecological blockage: what could grow into shared life is held as amassed property. Reading change: the ayah becomes a failed fertility image, not only greed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:30’s garden made the seed/growth branches much stronger: the final protected garden is the opposite of wealth-love that prevents provision from becoming living growth.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Wealth gathered into the heart's inner kernel.** **Evidence/cue:** `ح ب ب B002` is love as clinging attachment and `ح ب ب B004` the heart's inner kernel; `م و ل B001` is acquiring and having wealth, while `ج م م B001` supplies abundant gathered fullness. The backward context shows inherited shares gathered into one consumer. **Mechanism:** *jamman* concentrates acquired property, and clinging love moves that concentration inward until it occupies the self's evaluative center. The packet supplies outer gathering and inner attachment; the inward direction is inferred. **Reading change:** the doubled love construction describes capture of the heart's core by possession, not merely strong preference.

2. **Attachment as failure to move anything ahead.** **Evidence/cue:** besides love, `ح ب ب B005` describes an exhausted animal fixed in place; 89:24 activates forward advance through `ق د م B004/B006` when the speaker regrets not sending something ahead. **Mechanism:** clinging wealth immobilizes both possessor and possession, preventing present bounty from becoming prior merit. The packet supplies fixation and later non-advance; I infer attachment as the blocking cause. **Reading change:** love of wealth becomes arrested motion whose eventual verbal opposite is “I wish I had advanced.”
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:24 supplied the decisive opposite to attachment: forward undertaking exposed the fixed-in-place image of `ح ب ب B005`. The intervening leveling and forced remembrance reinforced the consequence, but did not add a cleaner lexical mechanism than the contrast between clinging and advance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dişlerin düzenli dizilişini ve dişlerin üzerinde tanecikler halinde görünen beyaz tükürük parıltısını açıkça birleştirir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi düzen ile beyaz görünüşü doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal diş dizilişi ve üzerindeki beyaz tükürük görünüşüyle sınırlıdır; su kabarcığı veya bitkisel tane anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal dişlerin düzeni ve beyaz görünüşüne ait yalın biçimi tanımlar; başka nesnelerdeki tane veya kabarcık anlamları eklenmez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal dişlerin düzenli dizilişini, beyazlığını ve güzel görünüşünü paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Düzen ve beyazlıkta yakın anlamlıdırlar; odak dal tanecikli tükürük görünüşüne özgüyken komşu dal diş yapısının düzgünlük, aralık ve genel güzellik özelliklerini daha geniş tutar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kısa veya küçük yapılı insanı ve küçükleri temel alırken zayıf develeri ayrıca aynı türemiş biçim alanında verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak insanın kısa ve küçük oluşu ile develerin zayıflığı tek bedensel özellik gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel alan kısa veya küçük beden yapısıdır; develerdeki cılızlık ayrı ve türemiş bir kullanım olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kısa veya küçük beden nitelemesiyle develere bağlı bir söz öbeğini içerir; deve cılızlığı genel kısa boy anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin sahip olduğu değerli varlıkların bütünü ile bunları edinme, çoğaltma ya da bunlara sahip duruma gelme alanıdır. Ayrıca başkasını varlık sahibi kılmayı kapsar; göçebe topluluklara özgü kullanımda sahip olunan varlık özellikle hayvan sürüleridir.

facets.statement: Kişinin sahip olduğu ve değer taşıyan varlıkların bütünü bu dalın ad çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Göçebe toplulukların varlığına ilişkin belirli kullanımda bu varlık, hayvan sürüleriyle somutlaşır.
Kişinin kendisi için değerli varlık edinmesi ve onu kalıcı sahiplik konusu yapması eylem çekirdeğidir.
Kişinin varlığının çoğalması ya da onun varlık sahibi bir duruma geçmesi ayrı bir süreç görünümüdür.
Bir başkasına değerli varlık vererek onu varlık sahibi duruma getirmek, çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısıdır.
Bir kimsenin varlığının çokluğuna şaşma bildiren söyleyiş, artış ve bolluk görünümüne bağlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, sahip olunan değerli varlıkları ve bunların çoğulunu temel alır; varlık edinme, varlığın çoğalması, varlıklı duruma gelme ve başkasını varlık sahibi kılma süreçlerini bu temel çevresinde birleştirir. Hayvan sürüleri göçebe topluluklara özgü somutlaşma, çokluk karşısındaki şaşma söyleyişi ise bağlı bir kullanım olarak aktarılır. Mal adının küçültme biçimi de ayrıca kaydedilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü savaşta mızrağı olmayan kişiyi, boynuzu olmayan koyunu, mazgalsız yapıyı ve dirsekleri çıkıntısız kadını birlikte verir. Ortak sınır, beklenen bir araç ya da belirgin çıkıntının bulunmamasıdır; dal çerçevesi bunu doğru biçimde yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yokluk, her türlü eksiklik değil; verilen varlıkta beklenen mızrak, boynuz, mazgal veya bedensel çıkıntının bulunmamasıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da nesnede beklenen savunma aracının, boynuzun veya belirgin çıkıntının bulunmamasıdır. Savaşçının mızraksız, koyunun boynuzsuz, yapının mazgalsız ve dirseklerin çıkıntısız oluşunda gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar beklenen araç veya çıkıntının yokluğunda birleşir; mızraksız savaşçı, boynuzsuz koyun, mazgalsız yapı ve çıkıntısız dirsek bu ortak görünümün ayrı uygulamalarıdır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

missing_branch_inventories.reason: no accepted, non-contaminated branch inventory in resource

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
